children.value: na kecana vaśaṃ yānti duḥkhasyāṅga bhavāniva
svastho bhava bhavodāraḥ samo bhava sukhī bhava
na kecana vaśaṃ yānti mṛgendrāḥ śikhināmiva
śaratkāla ivāmbhodaṃ taṃ me tvaṃ tanutāṃ naya
ātmanyeva hi saṃtuṣṭo na karoti na cehate
na tasyārtho nabhogatyā na siddhyā na ca bhogakaiḥ

maṇimantrādiyuktyaiva ākāśagamanādi itthaṃ siddhyatīti tattacchāstraprasiddho
niyateḥ kramaḥ tattanniyatikartṛbhistryakṣādibhirapi vyarthīkartuṃ na śakyate
niyatiṃ na jahātyeva śaśāṅka iva śītatām
anyathā niyatiṃ kartuṃ na śaktaḥ kaścideva hi
yathā viṣāṇi nighnanti madayanti madhūni ca
vamayanti ca śuktāni madanāni phalāni ca

yathā śuktāni
mākṣikamadhūni madanaphalāni vā khāditāni vamayanti udgiraṇaṃ kārayanti
ātmajñasya tu pūrṇasya necchā saṃbhavati kvacit
yathodeti ca yasyecchā sa tayā yatate tathā
ayaṃ me saṃśayo brahmanvītahavyasya sā tanuḥ
kravyādairna kathaṃ bhuktā kathaṃ klinnā na bhūtale
tanustiṣṭhati tacchede śaktā neha hi kecana
pāntho vyarthaṃ pathi grāme yathā grāmīṇakarmaṇi
anyacca śṛṇu me rāma spando nāśasya kāraṇam
vikāraḥ sa ca cittottho vātajo vā jagatsthitau
yataḥ sthitā dhāraṇayā tenānaṣṭāsya sā tanuḥ
na yasya vidyate tasya dūrasthau prakṛtikṣayau
dhātavaḥ saṃsthitiṃ dehe na tyajanti kadācana
tathā ca dṛśyate loke spandaśāntau dṛḍhā sthitiḥ
na klidyante na bhidyante magnavajjaladā iva
daivaṃ vāpi ca karmāṇi prāktanānyaihikāni ca
vāsanā vā na teṣāṃ tacceto niyamayantyalam
yadā tu tasya pratibhā videhonmuktatāṃ gatā

yadabhivāñchati tadbhavati kṣaṇā-
tsakalaśaktimayo hi maheśvaraḥ
